mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account (username, password, phone, id_card, status, role) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{idCard}, #{status}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, phone, id_card, password, status, role, create_time, update_time FROM account ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE account SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.username, up.avatar_url, up.bio, COUNT(f.id) AS total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT w.id) AS work_count FROM account a LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON a.id = up.account_id LEFT JOIN work w ON a.id = w.owner_id AND w.audit_status='APPROVED' LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.target_type='WORK' AND f.target_id = w.id WHERE a.role='USER' GROUP BY a.id HAVING total_favorites > 0 ORDER BY total_favorites DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.username, up.avatar_url, up.bio, COUNT(f.id) AS total_favorites, COUNT(DISTINCT w.id) AS work_count FROM account a LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON a.id = up.account_id LEFT JOIN work w ON a.id = w.owner_id AND w.audit_status='APPROVED' LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.target_type='WORK' AND f.target_id = w.id AND f.create_time >= #{weekStart} WHERE a.role='USER' GROUP BY a.id HAVING total_favorites > 0 ORDER BY total_favorites DESC LIMIT #{limit}
